items.title: A stack is a gerbe over an algebraic space exactly when its inertia is flat and locally of finite presentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's proposition characterizing when an algebraic stack is a gerbe over an algebraic space by flatness and local finite presentation of its inertia (source lines 6318-6326, label proposition-when-gerbe); the author's own proof at source lines 6328-6426 follows it immediately and is its proof. The forward direction passes to a flat finitely presented base change presenting the stack as a quotient by a group, computes the inertia as that group and descends; the converse realises the inertia through the stabilizer of a smooth presentation and applies the gerbe criterion (proof lines 6328-6425). The two reductions and the identification of the inertia with the acting or stabilizer group are the substance. H3.
